title: Telling the time
examples: Teacher, how do I know when it is half past?
What does the big hand show on the clock?
Can you show me quarter to using the clock?

explain.say: A clock has two hands. The small hand shows the hour. The big hand shows the minutes.
When the big hand points to twelve, it is o'clock. The small hand points to three. So it is three o'clock.
When the big hand points to six, it is half past. The big hand has gone half way round.
When the big hand points to three, it is quarter past. That is fifteen minutes after the hour.
When the big hand points to nine, it is quarter to. That is fifteen minutes before the next hour.

faq.q: What does the small hand show on the clock?
faq.a: The small hand shows the hour. It points to the hour number, or a little past it.
asks: What is the small hand for?

faq.q: How many minutes are in half past?
faq.a: Half past means thirty minutes have passed since the hour started. The big hand points straight down to the six.
asks: What is 30 minutes on a clock?
Where does the big hand go for half past?

faq.a: Quarter to means there are only fifteen minutes left until the next hour. The big hand points to the nine.
asks: If it is quarter to, how many minutes are left?
What time is it when the big hand is at the nine?

faq.q: Is 'quarter past' the same as 'quarter to'?
faq.a: No, they are different. Quarter past means fifteen minutes after the hour. Quarter to means fifteen minutes before the next hour.
asks: What is the difference between quarter past and quarter to?

faq.q: If the big hand is on the twelve, what time is it?
faq.a: If the big hand is on the twelve, it means the time is exactly o'clock. The small hand will point to the correct hour.
asks: What does the twelve on the clock mean?
What time is it when the big hand is at twelve?

facts: A full circle on a clock face is sixty minutes.
Each number on the clock face is five minutes apart for the big hand.
O'clock means the minutes are zero.
Half past means thirty minutes have passed.

quiz.say: Look at the hands. Tap the time.
quiz.show: 🕒 small hand on 3 · big hand on 12
quiz.why: The big hand on 12 means o'clock. The small hand on 3 means it is 3 o'clock.

wrong.0: Half past is when the big hand points to 6.
wrong.2: The big hand shows the minutes, so read the hour from the small hand.

quiz.say: Look at the big hand. Tap the time.
quiz.show: 🕡 small hand past 6 · big hand on 6
quiz.why: The big hand on 6 means half past. The small hand has passed 6, so it is half past 6.

wrong.1: At 6 o'clock the big hand points to 12.
wrong.2: At quarter past, the big hand points to 3.

quiz.say: Look at both hands. Tap the time.
quiz.show: big hand on 9 · small hand almost at 2
quiz.why: The big hand on 9 means quarter to. The small hand is almost at 2, so it is quarter to 2.

wrong.0: Quarter past is when the big hand points to 3.
wrong.1: The small hand is almost at 2, so the next hour is 2.
